title: Concept: Possible short alphanumeric password in a URL in source
description: In URLs, userinfo credentials (user:password@host) embed the password in the connection string itself. Short alphanumeric passwords are the weak-evidence class between the symbol-password rule and the 12-character rule.
applicability: Source and configuration files containing connection URLs with embedded userinfo credentials.
risk: A committed connection URL with an embedded password grants that access to anyone reading the repository.
